meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about that zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start there.
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
My child doesn't cheat. "I can prove it." Then put it on the table, Hale, because so far all I have is a zero nobody called me about.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.

I'm writing that down: created 11:31 PM, 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. "Pasted" is your word, and a document can be drafted anywhere and moved in, so turn the screen and show me the history yourself. And did you put any of this to Owen before you entered that zero?
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.

"Made up." Students misquote Shakespeare every day, Hale, and a wrong line proves a mistake, not who typed it. Show me the line in his essay next to the scene, and I'm still waiting to see that version history.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.
My child never lies to me. Are you calling me a liar as well, Hale? You've shown me nothing yet, and if this is how it goes, I'm walking into the principal's office the moment I leave this room.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

"Take it or leave it." Your own procedure, 4.4, says a supervised reassessment for a first concern replaces the mark and puts nothing on his record, so you're not offering me anything, you're describing his rights after skipping 4.1 and 4.2. Is anything on Owen's record right now, yes or no?
You don't get to turn that back on me, Hale. I asked you whether anything about this is on Owen's record, and I'm not answering anything until you do.
